problems: The clap is never visible: the figure by the pond is small, dark and half lost among the reeds in every storyboard frame and in the 25% still. Nothing shows hands coming together, so the light seems to start for no reason.

The caption says the echo lands on 'the two tree crowns', but in storyboard frames 8-13 and the 75% still a third crown lights up as well, the yellowish tree behind the left one. The film shows three crowns.

The echo points look just like the fireflies that drift over the dark sky and the far meadow the whole time (all frames, top centre). In the last row the leftover points on the grass can't be told apart from the fireflies, so the 'points mark where the echo lands' idea falls apart.
At the start (storyboard frames 3-6, 25% still) the pond surface itself flares into a broad bright cyan-white glow. That is a wash of light, not points, and it doesn't fit 'warm points'.
The points on the crowns are green-yellow on the left tree (50% and 75% stills), not warm, so the caption's colour word doesn't match half of what you see.
The two crowns that matter sit cut off at the left and right frame edges, and the right one is half outside the picture, while the middle of the frame is dark grass.
posts.critique: The spreading ring of light is pretty, but a viewer can't see a clap, can't tell echo points from the ambient fireflies, and counts three lit crowns where the caption says two. The pond flare also contradicts 'warm points'.
